title: Sextant
description: Fleet control plane for NixOS devices. Helm validates values against this schema on install and upgrade, so nothing here is marked required: a field that is required in practice but has a working default would turn an ordinary upgrade into a refusal. Types and choices are enforced; completeness is the wizard's job.

orgName.title: Organisation name
orgName.description: Shown in the console. One deployment serves one organisation.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Empty tracks the chart's appVersion, which is what you want unless you are pinning deliberately.

replicaCount.title: Console replicas
replicaCount.description: More than one needs persistence off: the volume is ReadWriteOnce and the chart refuses the combination.

secretName.title: Secret with SEXTANT_* keys
secretName.description: Name of an existing Secret in this namespace. It carries the sealing key and the database credentials; the chart never creates it, so the secret is not in anybody's git history.

write.title: Allow configuration writes
write.description: Off makes the console read-only, which is a real mode: a demo or a second replica that only shows state.

gateMode.title: Validation gate
gateMode.description: remote delegates every write to the gate-runner and is the only fail-closed option. eval needs nix in the console image, which the release image does not ship. none commits without validating and the chart refuses it unless allowUnvalidated is set.

allowUnvalidated.title: Acknowledge unvalidated writes
allowUnvalidated.description: Required to render gateMode: none together with write. Deliberately awkward.

engine.title: Network policy engine
engine.description: cilium ships CiliumNetworkPolicy, which is an unknown kind on any other CNI and fails the install there. kubernetes ships the same intent as plain NetworkPolicy. none leaves egress to the platform.

className.title: Ingress class
className.description: cilium, nginx, traefik: whatever this cluster runs.

oidc.title: Single sign-on
oidc.description: One SSO authority per deployment (ADR 0015). The console has no password login of its own, by design.

gitRemote.title: Fleet overlay repository
gitRemote.description: The git repository this console writes configuration to. Devices follow branches in it, so it is the fleet's source of truth rather than a backup target.

netrcSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the push credential.

enabled.description: Renders a CloudNativePG Cluster, so the CNPG operator has to be on the cluster.

storage.title: Database volume size
storage.description: WAL lives here. With archiving broken a small volume fills in hours, so this is not the place to be frugal.

backup.description: Off-cluster backup. The chart renders the object store and a scheduled backup together or neither: WAL archiving with no base backup cannot restore.

schedule.description: Six fields, seconds first. CNPG cron is not five-field cron.

gateRunner.title: Gate runner
gateRunner.description: Evaluates every candidate configuration with nix before it reaches git. Wants real memory and a volume; it is the safety property this product sells.
